scope: Batch 2 platform-governance and tenant-foundation plan after the agent-first baseline

tasks.title: 任务源标准化与批次切分
tasks.description: Create a canonical valid task source for the next execution wave and stop relying on the broken root task.json.
steps: Audit overlap between task.json and archived task files
Define the new batch file naming and source-of-truth rule
Document the archival and rollover rule for future batches

tasks.title: Epic 57 需求恢复与澄清
tasks.description: Recover the unreadable Epic 57 and FR1303-FR1329 text before any implementation depending on it is scheduled.
steps: Restore readable Epic 57 and FR1303-FR1329 text from source artifacts or version history
Clarify the boundary between Epic 57, Epic 42, and the common Agent runtime
Produce story-level task candidates and acceptance criteria for a later batch

tasks.title: 租户数据隔离架构
tasks.description: Implement the database-level tenant isolation baseline so all later platform and business features run inside a hard tenant boundary.
steps: Define tenant isolation model for cloud and local data stores
Enforce tenant_id as the root isolation identifier in APIs and persistence
Block cross-tenant access and add verification coverage

tasks.title: 租户注册与初始化
tasks.description: Create the tenant bootstrap flow so a new enterprise can be initialized with default settings and an administrator account.
steps: Build tenant registration and initialization flow
Create default tenant configuration and administrator seed data
Persist tenant bootstrap audit records and confirmation feedback

tasks.title: 租户管理员用户管理
tasks.description: Provide tenant-scoped user and role management without leaking or depending on other tenants.
steps: Build tenant-scoped user listing and management entry points
Limit all user and role operations to the active tenant boundary
Add guardrails and tests for forbidden cross-tenant operations

tasks.title: 租户级部门配置
tasks.description: Allow tenant administrators to control which department modules are enabled while keeping core departments mandatory.
steps: Expose tenant-level department enablement settings
Keep core departments always enabled and non-removable
Sync enabled modules to navigation and permission surfaces

tasks.title: 租户数据存储配置
tasks.description: Support tenant-level storage mode selection across local, cloud, and local-first plus cloud-backup modes.
steps: Expose tenant storage mode options and current usage state
Support local, cloud, and local-first plus cloud-backup configuration
Persist connection settings and provide connection test feedback

tasks.title: 租户配额与限制管理
tasks.description: Add tenant-level user, storage, and API usage quotas as the control baseline for later cost and package management.
steps: Define tenant quota model for users, storage, and API usage
Enforce quota checks at write and provisioning boundaries
Surface quota status and limit-reached guidance to administrators

tasks.title: 密钥保管库与审计
tasks.description: Create the enterprise key vault baseline with encrypted storage, scoped binding, and auditable access records.
steps: Implement encrypted key storage for local and cloud contexts
Support tenant, project, and user scope binding for managed keys
Record key access and use events into an auditable trail

tasks.title: 密钥轮换与吊销
tasks.description: Add lifecycle control for managed keys through rotation, expiry reminder, connectivity test, and emergency revocation.
steps: Support rotation policy, expiry reminder, and state transitions
Provide connection test and permission validation before activation
Allow one-click revocation and propagate invalidation outcomes safely

tasks.title: 工具权限声明与授权
tasks.description: Make tool permissions explicit and governable before execution so sensitive operations stay inspectable and policy-bound.
steps: Require tools to declare permission scope and risk level
Support user-level and admin-level authorization strategies
Expose permission and data-access scope to the user interface

tasks.title: 工具沙箱与执行限制
tasks.description: Add resource, filesystem, network, and timeout boundaries for tool execution to reduce platform risk.
steps: Enforce CPU, memory, disk, and timeout limits for tool execution
Support directory-level and domain-level whitelist policies
Add force-terminate flow and post-termination audit recording

tasks.title: 单点登录与MFA
tasks.description: Integrate enterprise identity entry points through SAML, OIDC, MFA, and auditable security policy control.
steps: Implement SAML and OIDC identity integration entry points
Support MFA and centralized security policy configuration
Record login and session activity into audit trails

tasks.title: 组织架构同步
tasks.description: Synchronize organization structure, mapping, and offboarding effects so identity and permissions stay aligned with enterprise reality.
steps: Integrate SCIM-based joiner and leaver synchronization
Support department and role mapping with conflict handling
Automatically revoke permissions and keys during offboarding

tasks.title: 数据分级与脱敏
tasks.description: Introduce data classification and field-level masking so sensitive information is protected consistently across runtime and admin surfaces.
steps: Define sensitivity levels and field-level data labels
Apply masking rules based on permission and display policy
Audit sensitive-field access and masking decisions

tasks.title: 数据保留与审计
tasks.description: Support retention, deletion approval, residency policy, and exportable compliance audit for governed data lifecycle management.
steps: Define retention, deletion, and destruction policy configuration
Require approval and records for governed deletion flows
Export compliance audit reports and residency-policy outcomes

tasks.title: 配额与预算管理
tasks.description: Create multi-level quota and budget controls for tenant, department, and user consumption.
steps: Define quota models for tenant, department, and user scopes
Support budget limits, alerts, and overage policy selection
Expose quota status and remaining budget to administrators

tasks.title: 成本归因与预估
tasks.description: Provide cost attribution and pre-execution estimation so administrators can understand and control runtime spend.
steps: Attribute cost by tool, Agent, project, and execution context
Show estimated cost before high-cost task execution
Link cost reporting to quota and overage strategy feedback

tasks.title: 插件权限与审核
tasks.description: Introduce plugin permission declaration, review flow, and private repository governance before broader business-module expansion.
steps: Require plugins to declare permissions and data-access scope
Build review and approval flow for plugin publishing and enablement
Support enterprise private plugin repository governance

tasks.title: 插件信誉与依赖治理
tasks.description: Add plugin reputation, dependency conflict handling, and deprecation guidance to reduce runtime risk.
steps: Detect and surface plugin dependency conflicts with remediation guidance
Add plugin rating and reputation model for governance views
Support deprecation, migration hints, and controlled replacement flow

tasks.title: 数据迁移向导
tasks.description: Create the guided migration baseline with field mapping, rehearsal, preview, and incremental import support.
steps: Build migration wizard with step-by-step flow and saved progress
Support reusable field-mapping templates and pre-import validation
Add rehearsal, preview, batch, and incremental migration modes

tasks.title: 迁移校验与报告
tasks.description: Add migration quality reporting, anomaly marking, and exportable migration completion evidence.
steps: Generate migration quality checks and anomaly classification
Produce completion report with import summary and exception list
Link migration reports to logs, trace data, and audit exports
